title: extract_with_repair input
description: Input for extract_with_repair: identical to structured_extract's input. The source is inline text or a host-authorized file and exactly one must be supplied; the exactly-one rule is a `oneOf` over the two required-key branches, so a document carrying both satisfies both branches and fails the `oneOf`. The schema subset is the same one, sanitised by the same code, because the repair attempt must be judged against the contract the caller actually expressed.

path.description: A path the HOST authorizes through resolvePath; the resolved path is what is read, so a check-then-open window cannot be won by a symlink.

instruction.description: What to extract, in the caller's words. It is a prompt, so it is the caller's responsibility; the ENGINE's grammar, not this text, is what makes the result well-formed.

schema.description: A JSON Schema object describing the record to extract. Only the subset the engine's grammar compiler accepts is used: `type`, `properties`, `required`, `items`, `enum`, `const` and `description`. Unsupported keywords are REFUSED by name rather than silently dropped, because a dropped constraint produces a plausible object that violates the caller's contract.

system.description: Session facts: the date, the locale, the device.
